notes.title: ⭐ New content available: 1680s women's fashion! ⭐
notes.content:
[h2]Exciting news![/h2]

[i]Historical Fashion Dress Up[/i] has a new time period to explore! 

The 1680s women's pack is now available to play! The pack showcases the fashion of everyday life, highlighting the styles worn by the middle class, moving beyond the grandeur of formal ballgowns.

In this content pack you get:
[list]
[*] a new character with 15 new hairstyles
[*] a new tailor in a new setting
[*] new pack-specific events and garment information
[*] 7 historical preset outfits
[*] 28 outfit pieces
[*] 20 accessories
[*] 11 historical backdrops
[/list]
There will be a weeklong sale to celebrate the new content pack! [b]33% off[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692430/Historical_Fashion_Dress_Up/


[b]Screenshots form the 1680s content pack:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/c22bad6f6755ecd01289a19d52fb0234eca2b2e3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/f3c4d720680d57c72b9009742318c9f4294655ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/a05915142d9f1d1486f53ceb3772a2d6148da65d.png[/img]

[b]We also added new content and fixed bugs in the 1820s packs, here are the patch notes:[/b]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added five new patterns for 1820s dresses
[*] Added a new 1820s dress preset
[*] Added seven new presets for 1820s gentlemen 
[*] Fixed. Made the reset button more reliable
[*] Changed. Made new in-game capsule images for the 1820s content packs which showcase the characters rather than the tailors
[*] Changed. Made it more convenient to swap between content packs
[*] Changed. Sped up opening menu transitions
[*] Changed. Improved colouring mode print option by tinting pre-coloured items black and white
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*] Characters will occasionally blush after loading a save
[/list]

[b]Heads up:[/b] With the new content, there might be a few unexpected bugs lurking around. We're working on squashing them, but if you spot one, let us know! 


Thank you to everyone who has played so far, we hope you will enjoy this new content as well! ⭐
- Maria from Tidvis

notes.title: 1680s fashion - update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re putting the 1880s pack on hold for now to focus on the 1680s. We're currently working on a project centered around the 1680s, and we want to use our research to create the 1680s pack before the project is finished.

The 1680s pack will highlight more "everyday" outfits and explore the fashion of various societal classes rather than elaborate ballgowns. We hope you are as excited as we are so have some more fashion to explore in [b]Historical Fashion Dress Up![/b]

Here are some sketches:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/4b8c14f7ce640f6e4c06744a108935a2c24cffbb.png[/img]


We have been using a lot of Dutch paintings as reference for this fashion pack. Here is one of the references: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/e454fa5fe03b4c15905d71d149b1402487726a20.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.nga.gov/collection/art-object-page.1220.html]"The Dancing Couple"[/url]

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Working on 1880s content!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We know it's been a while since our last update, but we have some exciting news. We're currently diving into [b]1880s fashion![/b] We are hard at work researching and sketching dresses to bring more fashion to [i]Historical Fashion Dress Up.[/i] 

[h2]1880s Fashion is coming[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/da2b9e28909abcca47a6018aa594a700ae422096.jpg[/img]
The 1880s is a fascinating period for fashion, often recognized from westerns. This era features distinctive styles such as tailored fitted jackets and elaborate dresses with bustles! 


Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Color Swatch Update! + more
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Thank you again so much for playing and giving feedback on the game! Based on the comments we have just released a new patch for Historical Fashion Dress Up on both Windows and Mac.

[h2]New dress![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/a438ab26e7827a12914fdc36e558b436a5ddd7bd.png[/img]

[h2]New color swatches![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/7c8776dbede1c11821419d7b18a9d4e0037e199e.png[/img]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added a new dress preset for the 1820s female pack, including 3 new decorations and a new pattern.
[*] Added. Doubled the number of colors across all garments (!)
[*] Fixed. The hat menu no longer let’s you change the hair color
[*] Fixed. Setting changes properly save
[*] Changed. If the game does not detect the Steam Overlay, it saves a screenshot locally. Due to Steamworks API limitations this is the only screenshot option for Mac users, other than using the built-in hotkey.
[/list]


What to look forward to in our next patch/update:
[list]
[*] More font options and font sizes
[*] More patterns for both ladies and gentlemen (1820s) across garments
[/list]

Please let us know what other features and additions you would like to see in Historical Fashion Dress Up!

Thanks for playing!
- Maria from Tidvis

notes.title: Historical Fashion Dress Up is out now!
notes.content:
Historical Fashion Dress Up is out now with it's first pack!

Enjoy the 1820s in the first fashion pack, with more historical fashion to come! Step into the shoes of Tailor Hoff or Seamstress Madam Lind, and create your own Mr. Darcy or Miss Bennet. It’s all up to you!

[previewyoutube=pJ3n-Jc7kG4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🌷Play the game here🌷[/h2]
You can enjoy [i]Historical Fashion Dress Up[/i] on PC, Mac, iOS and Android!
[olist]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692430/Historical_Fashion_Dress_Up/]Steam[/url]
[*] [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/historical-fashion-dress-up/id6479529042]App Store[/url]
[*] [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Tidvis.HistoricFashionDressUp]Google Play[/url]
[/olist]
[b][i]Historical Fashion Dress Up[/i] Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Play with 1820s fashion
[*] Customise your character
[*] Attend different events
[*] Build your wardrobe
[*] Print your paper dolls
[/list]
A casual and captivating experience for historical fashion enthusiasts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/5f8a58600cd88cc1c09cb8c1df7ed3e2c24f4da5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/1e9d479db6d91fe3a92765ceb2a70502c14a5924.png[/img]
[h3]✨Please review the game on Steam! It helps us immensely!✨[/h3]
If you enjoy playing please consider leaving a review here on steam and share your thoughts on the game. It helps with visibility and makes the game easier to discover for even more historical fashion lovers! Thank you in advance!

Share your creations and tag us! We would love to see what you all make! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752804/926980f0603f7d7580fe2832eae69b3a710ad2b9.png[/img]
